articles.title: Oops! Paul Pelosi Hits a Parked Car and Drives Off
articles.summary: Paul Pelosi, husband of Nancy Pelosi, hit a parked car in California and drove away. No one was hurt, but he could face charges.

articles.title: Iran's Supreme Leader Gets a Huge Funeral — What Does It All Mean?
articles.summary: Iran's late Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral uses symbols like a clenched fist and red flags to send political messages. It's a big event with lots of meaning.
